A playful romantic melody filled with the musical magic of the 80s! “Tu Maike Mat Jaiyo” from the 1983 Bollywood film Pukar features the charismatic pairing of Amitabh Bachchan and Zeenat Aman. Composed by the legendary R. D. Burman, this memorable song brings together delightful romance, catchy music and the unmistakable charm of classic Bollywood cinema.
